description.value:
A chili sauce crafted by a renowned chefhealer, known for its ability to warm the stomach even in the harshest cold. Its fiery flavor is so irresistible, it's to die for — figuratively, of course.
However, the creator cheekily claims that its most effective "medical benefit" is curing those who boast about being "immune to spiciness."

"Hashafasasha... Not spicy at all! I am serious! This ain't spicy at all!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Speed increases by 5 feet. Its Strength also increases by 1, maximum 20. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by 8% and their ATK by 15% for the next battle.
